scope: Read-only existing official-addon Run construction reference, separate from fresh live viewer evidence.
construction_observations: The crest parent has a central two-cuboid swept structure. Root profile is 3×3×6 and terminal 2×2×3; parent rotation 30 degrees X and terminal -15 degrees X.
Two mirrored rear-side spike assemblies each have a 3×5×3 root and 2×3×4 terminal, with opposing yaw and stepped angled cuboid construction.
Two zero-thickness side cards on skull and the raised eye/brow cubes are unsuitable as production closed features or replacements for canonical eyes.
Feet are 2×2×5 cuboids and hands are compact 2×2×2 cubes. The wings are zero-thickness 3×2 cards; a closed-surface production interpretation is required.
The atlas is green/cyan/lime with original pixel eyes; it is a construction reference and not the correct complete color palette for every Neutral Run age/specialization.

inspection_image.operation: Nearest-neighbor enlargement only; original source unchanged
